title: Kobra Engine Manifest
description: Companion to game/engine/engine.manifest.json. Declares engine compatibility metadata and the features the shell must detect before starting the engine. Spec Appendix B.2. The v2.0 bridge/preload blocks are REMOVED: they existed only to work around asynchronous File System Access reads, which v2.1 eliminates.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Readers MUST reject an unknown major version and MUST accept higher minor versions, ignoring unknown fields.

release.description: Release identifier this engine ships in, e.g. 2026.09.1.

engine_version.description: Semantic version of the engine core.

wasm_hash.description: Mandatory-at-install hash of the WASM binary. Verified by the launcher during update, not at every boot.

save_version.description: Save format version this engine reads and writes. MUST equal the release manifest save_version or the release build fails (FR-SCH-5).

required_features.description: WASM and browser features the engine requires. The shell MUST feature-detect these and fail into the error matrix entry E1/E12 rather than at first use.

min_browser.description: Engine-level minimums. The product-wide minimum is Chrome/Edge 105 (Section 15.1); an engine MAY require more.

maximum_bytes.description: Engine memory ceiling. Spec target is under 1.2 GiB (Section 17.1).

hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 with an algorithm prefix.

enginePath.description: Path under engine/. The engine and glue are load-bearing: they MUST NOT live outside engine/ (FR-AST-12).
